Poople: Free Daily Word Ladder Game Online

pooplegame.com
https://pooplegame.com
Play Poople, the free daily word ladder game. Change a 4-letter word into POOP one letter at a time, then share your result with no spoilers.
AI Overview
Poople is a free, daily word-ladder puzzle game where the goal is to transform a random four-letter starting word into the word POOP in as few steps as possible. 
How to Play
Change one letter: Each new word must differ from the previous word by only a single letter. 
Use real words: Every intermediate step must be a valid English dictionary word. 
Match the par: The game scores your run based on how close you get to the shortest possible path (par). 
Firefox Add-ons
 +1
Daily reset: A new global puzzle goes live every day at 08:00 UTC, and everyone around the world solves the exact same word. 
Where to Play
Official Website: Play the daily puzzle directly on Poople or Poople Game. 
Practice Mode: Try Poople Unlimited for endless random word ladders. 
Mobile Apps: Download the mobile version via the Poople App Store.
